tools.name: openapi_sync_validate
tools.description: Validate the openapi-sync config file and all configured API specs without writing any files to disk. Use this as a pre-flight check before syncing. Returns a structured result with per-API validity and endpoint counts.

authHeader.description: Custom header in 'Key: Value' format (used with authType: custom).

apiUrl.description: Direct URL to OpenAPI specification (JSON or YAML).

apiFile.description: Direct local file path to OpenAPI specification.

api.description: API specification source (<name>=<url>, direct URL, or name to filter).

server.description: Default server index or base URL override.

configJson.description: Raw JSON string defining an openapi-sync configuration.

tools.name: openapi_sync_list_endpoints
tools.description: Fetch and parse all configured OpenAPI specs, then return a structured list of every endpoint (name, HTTP method, path, tags, summary). No files are written. Use this to understand the API surface before deciding on a client type or tag filters.

tools.name: openapi_sync_sync
tools.description: Run a full openapi-sync — fetches all configured OpenAPI specs and writes TypeScript types, endpoint builder functions, and optional validation schemas (Zod/Yup/Joi) to disk. tools.name: openapi_sync_generate_client
tools.description: Generate a fully-typed API client for one or all configured APIs. Supports: fetch, axios, react-query, swr, rtk-query, next-fetch. Syncs the latest spec first, then writes client files to disk (unless dryRun: true). Returns a SyncResult with the list of files written.

type.description: The type of API client to generate.

baseURL.description: Base URL to bake into the generated client (e.g. https://api.example.com). Can be overridden at runtime in the generated code.

outputDir.description: Custom output directory for the generated client files (alias for output).

tags.description: Only generate client methods for endpoints with these tags.

endpoints.description: Only generate client methods for these specific endpoint names / operationIds.

useCache.description: Reuse cached endpoints when available instead of reloading specs.

dryRun.description: Show what files would be written without writing them.

verbose.description: In dry-run mode, also include full endpoint listing in output.

tools.name: openapi_sync_init
tools.description: Create an openapi.sync config file in the current working directory without any interactive prompts. First-class authentication and runSync are supported.

apiName.description: A short identifier for this API used as a folder name and config key (e.g. 'petstore', 'my-api'). Letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only.

apiSource.description: URL to the OpenAPI spec (https://...) or relative path to a local file (e.g. ./api/openapi.yaml).

apiUrl.description: Direct URL to OpenAPI specification (JSON or YAML).

apiFile.description: Direct path to a local OpenAPI specification file.

outputFolder.description: Output folder for generated files (default: '' project root).

clientType.description: Client type to pre-configure in the config. Omit to skip client generation.

validationLibrary.description: Validation library to pre-configure. Omit to skip validation schema generation.

folderSplit.description: Organize generated files into folders by OpenAPI tags.

typesPrefix.description: Prefix for generated TypeScript interface names (default: 'I', e.g. IPet).

useOperationId.description: Use operationId from spec for naming (default: true).

showCurl.description: Include cURL examples in generated docs (default: false).

refetchInterval.description: Auto-refetch interval in milliseconds (omit to disable).

runSync.description: If true, immediately run a full sync after creating the config file.

preset.description: Starter preset configuring client type, validation library, and conventions in one option.

authType.description: Spec authentication type (bearer, basic, apiKey, custom).

authToken.description: Bearer token or password value / env var reference for auth.

authName.description: API key header or query param name (default: X-API-Key).

authIn.description: API key location: header or query (used with authType: apiKey).

authHeader.description: Custom header in 'Key: Value' format (used with authType: custom).

tools.name: openapi_sync_read_config
tools.description: Read the current openapi.sync config file from the working directory and return its contents as a string. Useful to inspect what APIs are configured before running sync or generate-client.
